description: For every fixed PA derivation of the universal closure of \(A(\vec x)\), the specified universal-elimination program produces an accepted certificate for the actual numeral-instance code \(\operatorname{sub}_A(\vec n)\), at every internal input tuple in every PA model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.certified_specializeFixed.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {r : ℕ}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r))
  (hA :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.close A))
  (x : Fin r → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.specializeFixed A hA).value x)
    ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.substitution A).value x)
